newsitem.title: UK: UK's Principal Hotels sees strong profit growth.
newsitem.headline: UK's Principal Hotels sees strong profit growth.

text.p: Principal Hotels, the company that plans to go public through a placing in November, said on Friday it expects operating profit in the year ending October 27 to rise to 11.8 million stg from 8.1 million.
Including this year's results, the group, which has 21 hotels, will have achieved a total rise in operating profit of 76 percent in the last three years.
Principal Hotels has already presented itself to several institutional investors, who showed a "fairly positive response", managing director Tony Troy told Reuters.
